user.title: Connect Mealie Atelier
user.description: Your API token stays in Home Assistant. This complements, not replaces, the built-in Mealie integration.

data_description.url: Use the full address Home Assistant can reach, for example http://192.168.1.20:9000. For the Mealie Home Assistant app, use port 9090. Do not use an ingress or login URL.
data_description.api_token: Create a token in Mealie under Profile → Manage Your API Tokens. It is stored securely by Home Assistant and must never go in card YAML.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave this enabled. Disable it only for a self-signed certificate on a trusted local network.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the Mealie token.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http(s) Mealie URL.
error.cannot_connect: Mealie is unreachable or returned an error.

data.read_only: Read-only: block changes to recipes, meal plans and shopping lists
data.experimental_ingredient_edits: Experimental: allow free-text ingredient replacement (backup Mealie first; linked ingredients remain protected)
data.usda_fdc_api_key: USDA FoodData Central API key (for nutrition lookup)
data.openai_api_key: OpenAI API key (optional, only for food search suggestions)
